name: Background Processing
trigger: Something in your process takes minutes rather than seconds, and you do not want the screen to freeze or the work to be lost.
summary: Hard dependency for docs.extraction, automation.rules, and every integration capability. Validation raises an error rather than a warning when those are selected without it. Supersedes kernel.work: enqueue() and schedule() keep their signatures, so no consumer changes, but the work is now durable, retried, and observable.

requires.reason: Job lifecycle is published onto the bus so the monitor and observability can see it.

enhances.unlocks: durable retry, dead-lettering, concurrency limits, and replay for every capability doing asynchronous work

owns.name: JobAttempt
owns.description: Append-only attempt history. Retained so a flapping job's failure pattern is visible rather than overwritten.

exposes.name: enqueue
exposes.description: Satisfies kernel.work's enqueue. Same signature, durable semantics.

external.purpose: Durable job storage, leasing, and scheduling.

credentials.name: QUEUE_URL
credentials.description: Connection string for the queue backend. For the 'postgres' driver this may be the application database URL.

driver.description: Phase 1 defaults to the Postgres-backed driver so a local workspace needs no second service. Redis is available where throughput justifies the operational cost.

slots.name: retryPolicies
slots.when: when a failed job's next attempt is scheduled
slots.description: Client-specific backoff and give-up rules per job kind.

slots.name: concurrencyLimits
slots.description: Client-specific per-kind concurrency, usually to protect a rate-limited third party.

slots.name: priorityRules
slots.when: when the next job is selected

smoke.name: work survives a restart
smoke.asserts: a job enqueued before a process restart still runs after it — the property kernel.work does not have

smoke.name: failures retry then dead-letter
smoke.asserts: a persistently failing job retries to max_attempts and then dead-letters exactly once

smoke.name: a dead-lettered job replays
smoke.asserts: replay re-enqueues the job with its original payload intact

contract.scenario: an existing product upgrades from in-process work to the durable queue
contract.asserts: every caller of enqueue and schedule continues to compile and run unchanged, and in-flight kernel.work jobs are migrated rather than dropped

migrations.description: Moves pending kernel.work jobs into the durable queue. Required by the upgrade declaration: an upgrade with no migration path cannot be applied to a live client.

templates.description: Worker entry point with the job registry from the resolved graph.
